chapters.text: Right now the Hobo Bag is fifty percent off in the Early Black Friday sale, and the matching pouch wallet comes with it.
Two straps in the box. Clip on the short one for a handbag, the long one for crossbody.
Your cards go in the hidden back pocket, flat against you. Keys and phone go in the gold side zips.
It's fifty percent off with free shipping, and the sale ends on the thirtieth of November. Tap the link below.
